name: Eau Palm Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: Oceanfront resort and spa on the Palm Beach shoreline, officially Eau Resort & Spa, with ocean-view rooms and suites, Eau Spa and Nobu Manalapan
best_for: Travelers who want oceanfront rooms with a private balcony or terrace
Families, with Kids and Teen Clubs and water sports

facts.text: The Ocean Front rooms sit directly along the shoreline, with uninterrupted ocean views from a private balcony.
The Lanai Terrace Rooms are ground-level rooms with a private patio terrace and easy access to the pools and the beach.
Club Level rooms and suites come with exclusive Club Level access and lounge privileges.
The Presidential Suite has expansive living spaces and panoramic ocean views.
The Resort View rooms each have a private balcony with views across the resort's gardens and grounds.
The resort offers tennis, private daybeds and fitness.
The resort hosts weddings and events along Palm Beach's shoreline.
Savor, located within Eau Spa, serves fresh salads, bowls and wellness-focused cuisine.
Breeze Ocean Kitchen is an oceanfront restaurant open for lunch and a relaxed dinner, with a Sunday brunch.

highlights.text: The Ocean Front Lanai Terrace Suites are ground-level suites with private terraces opening directly to the Atlantic and poolside living.
Nobu Manalapan, at the resort, serves Nobu Matsuhisa's Japanese cuisine with Peruvian influences, including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Jalapeno.
The resort has Kids and Teen Clubs.

considerations.text: Non-hotel guests are welcome at the restaurants, and reservations are recommended.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited availability during peak season.
